verdict.rationale: Kimi's own docs show it working directly on the user's data inside the product. The Kimi Code Agent reads a local project folder, loads an entire codebase for whole-project understanding, and is positioned for large codebase analysis and long-document processing. The editor sidebar adds code completion. However, the evidence frames this as coding help rather than explicit insights or suggestions surfaced from user data. missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI-generated insights/suggestions over user data (beyond code/document analysis), coverage of non-code personal or business data, independent hands-on corroboration of insight quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: A million-token context loads an entire large codebase with cross-module dependencies in one pass, enabling whole-project understanding and refactoring.
Best for large codebase analysis, multi-file refactoring, and long-document processing.
Open a local project folder in Kimi Code Desktop and let the Agent read code, edit files, run commands, and verify results through conversation.
Collaborate with AI in the editor sidebar, supporting code completion, file editing, web search, and automated tasks.
